_comment: Community Test Board registry — features awaiting playtest. `ref` is a stable searchable token that also appears in the linked test sheet, so searching the wiki/docs for it finds the sheet. Ordering is computed at load (test_board::rank_items): features gating the most downstream work first, then by `priority`. Maintained by the build team; append a row when a feature ships and needs testing, remove it once green.

items.title: WorldEdit region tools (/we)
items.summary: Pos1/pos2 select, set/replace/walls, copy + paste, stack. Big builds in seconds.

items.title: Schematic import (/import)
items.summary: Load a Sponge .schem into a blueprint and place it. Community builds come in.

items.title: Blueprint build guide (/buildguide)
items.summary: Ghost-cell overlay shows each block to place; cells flip as you build it correctly.

items.title: Minimap, map screen & waypoints
items.summary: Corner minimap, M full-screen map, place/remove waypoints, death markers.

items.title: Tiered chests + auto-collect
items.summary: Copper/Iron/Diamond/Satori chests with bigger grids; Diamond+ pull nearby drops.

items.title: Spawn-proofing overlay (F7)
items.summary: Toggle markers on blocks dark enough for mobs to spawn. Light it up, markers clear.

items.title: Combat sweep attack
items.summary: A swing hits the crosshair mob full + every other mob in the arc for reduced damage.

items.title: Accessibility narration (TTS)
items.summary: Opt-in spoken hotbar selection via the browser voice. Toggle in the menu.

items.title: Electricity — power & logic (Phase 1)
items.summary: Wire a circuit: lever/button/plate/crank/generator/battery -> cable -> a lamp that lights. Logic gates, powered rail. /give or craft the parts.

items.title: Electricity — light beams & motion (Phase 2)
items.summary: Beam Sensor triplines: walk through the red beam to trigger it. Mirrors route it (180 deg + 90 deg turns); Motion Sensor trips on proximity.

items.title: Feature-coverage challenges
items.summary: In-game challenges that send you to try a feature. /scenario list to find them, /scenario <name> to start (onboarding, tame-wolf, vendor-sale...). HUD tracks progress.

items.title: Native LAN multiplayer (host + join)
items.summary: Two desktop machines on one network: one hosts a world, the other auto-discovers it (or joins by ip:port). Play together — moves + block edits sync. Native-only; browsers can't host. Backs the homepage 'host a LAN game' promise.

items.title: Solid ground — no void holes
items.summary: Make a new Normal world. Walk ~50 blocks each way and dig straight down. The floor should be continuous to bedrock — no bottomless grid gaps, and you never fall through.

items.title: Meet Satoshi (new-world welcome)
items.summary: In a new Normal world, Satoshi waits in a small wooden hut near spawn. Right-click him: he greets you, offers food (Survival), then gifts a starter-hut plan.

items.title: Build along a schematic
items.summary: Lay the starter plan. Short on materials -> a build-guide + shopping list. With the materials -> choose 'build automatically' or 'guide me'. Guided glows the lowest unbuilt layer and walks upward as you place blocks.
